keyVerseDR: "I am the living bread which came down from heaven." (Jn 6:51 DR)

level1.title: Living Bread
level1.story: Some people grumbled about Jesus. Jesus said, "I am the living bread from heaven." Whoever eats this bread will live forever.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Where did the living bread come from?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are the living bread. Amen.

activity.title: Read it 3 times
activity.intro: Point to each word as you read the verse 3 times.
items: Whoever eats this bread will live forever.

level2.title: Bread From Heaven
level2.story: The people murmured because Jesus said, "I am the bread which came down from heaven." They said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know?" Jesus said no one can come to Him unless the Father draws him. He said, "Your fathers did eat manna in the desert, and are dead." But Jesus said, "I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever."
level2.keyLine: I am the living bread which came down from heaven.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'my flesh for the life of the world' point to?
level2.prayer: Father, draw me to Your Son. Amen.

activity.title: The word that touched me
activity.intro: Copy the verse. Highlight the word that touched you most.
activity.text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever.
